card.name: Linking words around prodrugs and metabolites
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word-starts right before a drug name, mostly where a prodrug, active metabolite or related compound is being named, e.g. 'prodrug of', 'is the active metabolite', 'converted to'.

modes.label: Prodrug/metabolite links
modes.description: A word like of, to, the or and linking a parent drug to its prodrug, metabolite or product.
modes.example: IE1 in the patient's liver which, in turn, resulted in a greater proportion of the ingested acetaminophen being converted<< to>> the toxic metabolites.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name or just before a bracketed drug name.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a drug name, especially when one drug is described as the prodrug or metabolite of another.
